scope: pure schema-prefix, token-support conditioning and deterministic draw component

schema_contract.rows: one ordered singleton object per exact input token, including repeated tokens
schema_contract.values: [] or exactly eight strings; no silent filling, deletion or repair
schema_contract.candidate_surface: nonempty trimmed; distinct after whitespace collapse and casefold; exclude source surface
schema_contract.unicode: strict UTF-8; JSON surrogate escapes only as valid pairs; partial escapes/UTF-8 require a legal schema continuation

prefix_semantics: abstract schema viability, not existence of a completion in model vocabulary/top50 or remaining512token/bytebudget

support.input: explicit list of unique nonnegative token IDs, nonempty exact bytepieces, positive integer masses
support.EOS_and_special_tokens: caller must exclude; component cannot identify them from bytes
support.ordering: ascending token ID, preserving distinct IDs even if bytepieces equal
support.mask: allow only whole token pieces extending to incomplete or complete required schema
support.resource_limit: refuse whole step if any supplied candidate exceeds bytebudget; never silently grammar-mask it
support.empty_support: known refusal; no top_k expansion, repair, fallback, seed search or automatic retry
support.duplicate_piece_ids: retain separate categorical events; do not merge their mass
support.complete_prefix: stop without generating EOS or trailing tokens

probability.base: supplied discrete law q_i=m_i/M; no logits or full-vocabulary distribution observed
probability.conditional: q_i_given_schema=m_i/S for eligible IDs, S=sum eligible masses; zero otherwise
probability.retained_fraction: S/M; null when input support is empty (0/0 is undefined)
probability.native_proposal_not_run: condition the complete EOS/special-masked temperature0.7 top50 integer2^24 law; no full-vocabulary recovery or top50 widening
probability.top50_limitation: empty support is possible even where a legal token exists outside top50
probability.distribution_shift: schema-conditioning generally changes the base distribution; no stealth or indistinguishability claim

draw.rejection: accept block<floor(2^256/S)*S then ticket=block%S; ascending-ID mass intervals
draw.counter: 0..127, then resource refusal; never substitute key or seed
draw.bindings: law digest includes sourceword hash, rawprefix hash, base-law hash and complete conditional metadata
draw.integrity_limit: hash is not authentication or proof of genuine model/tokenizer evidence; adapter/auditor must reconstruct law
draw.fixture_key: bytes(range(32)) is a public synthetic-test fixture only; no native key or run is activated

native_followup_gates: separate new native ID and bounded protocol
full vocabulary/tokenpiece and logits evidence binding with independent law reconstruction
Git-pinned source, disabled activation, separate enabled intent and actual readback
single project NN lease; no old-v1/v2 rerun
nonclaims: not a useful stego codec or semantic certification
synthetic fixture tests are not model attempts
